ev.q: CDC compared the prevalence of hearing impairment within nine U.S. industry sectors using 1,413,789 noise-exposed worker audiograms
Across all industries, 2.53 healthy years were lost annually per 1,000 noise-exposed workers
Among all industries, 13% of noise-exposed workers had any impairment and 2% had moderate or worse impairment
